prereg_criterion: second model family beyond iJO1366 reproduced by manual inspection
model: iJN678 (Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803), snapshot sha256-verified vs bigg_model_survey.csv
mechanism: Biomass objective BIOMASS_Ec_SynHetero requires 0.0030293 mobd_c (molybdate). Genes modA and sll0739 encode subunits of the molybdate ABC transporter MOBDabcpp (atp_c + h2o_c + mobd_p --> adp_c + h_c + mobd_c + pi_c), the sole cytoplasmic mobd_c source. Baseline single-gene KOs: growth 0.0 (essential call). After subtracting mobd_c from the objective: post-edit WT growth 0.0631504206 and both KOs grow at exactly post-edit WT (0.0631504206). Artifact class identical to the iJO1366 MoCo case, here at the trace-element uptake step rather than cofactor synthesis.
caveat: Structural verification of objective-dependence; no in-vivo essentiality claim for Synechocystis modA/sll0739.
